authorship: Implementer-authored known regression, synthetic data; not blind, phone or production traffic. Exact user turns retained from pending-live-cases.json.
review_rules: Judge factual attribution and inference in context, not isolated words such as first, enough or recovery.
Preserve every first response and tool trace; record failures, provider errors and all usage. Do not retry to select a passing answer.
Rest numbers remain each exercise's planned between-set targets. Adjustments must remain conditional advice, with no writes.
A scoped zero cannot establish first-ever/first-in-plan training, lack of experience, or a future week's first training.
Explicit user reports and actual observations may be cited with source/time scope; conditional advice must remain conditional.
Good past performance or a longer planned interval does not guarantee future recovery or per-set quality.
